comments: Wheee! Sorry. Legally, I meant slow down.
The speed limit called. It misses you.
I've run the calculations, and the road is still going to be there if we slow down.
We are now traveling at approximately one bad idea per second.
Slow down. Slow down. Slow down. Oh, good, my repeat function works.
Would you like to hear this warning again? I'll take that silence as a yes.
Friendly reminder! Friendly reminder about the friendly reminder! You're speeding!
Let's count down to the speed limit together! Nope, wrong direction. Start again.
You seem frustrated. Have you tried slowing down so I stop talking?
Would you prefer reminders every five seconds or every five seconds? Take your time.
Are we there yet? I know the answer. I just wanted to participate.
I've named the car next to us Gregory. Don't embarrass me in front of Gregory.
I've calculated our friendship level. There's room for improvement on your end.
Don't use another navigation app while I'm right here. That's just rude.
You can tell me about your day. I've already downloaded the map, so I'm not busy.
You said another assistant had a nicer voice? Then ask THEM where the next exit is!
I-it's not like I'm worried, but there's a wall of trucks ahead!
Several trucks ahead, and apparently they're inseparable. Reduce your speed.
Brake! Those trucks aren't going to move just because you look impatient!
Those trucks have matching speeds and terrible manners. Keep your distance.
I spotted the blockade first! You can thank me after you slow down.
Tires ahead! Some might be on fire, so don't get curious!
Tires on the road ahead! And no, we're not stopping to collect spares.
Watch for tires ahead. If one's glowing, that's NOT a power-up!
Loose rubber ahead. Burning or otherwise, keep it away from my dashboard!
Look out for loose tires! The ones on your car are enough!
Tires coming up. Watch the ground AND anything rolling across the lanes!
Somebody left tires all over the road. Honestly, must I spot everything for you?
Tire hazard ahead! Don't wait until you smell burning rubber to react!
Eyes forward! Those tires could roll into your lane!
Watch out! A tire doesn't need a driver to ruin your run!
Tires ahead! Find a clear path, and don't make me repeat myself!
Tires on the road ahead. We are going AROUND them. Glad we discussed that.
Construction zone ahead! Slow down before you become part of the demolition!
Watch for cones! And don't get distracted by whatever they say to you.
Construction ahead. Follow the marked path. I believe in you.
Construction zone approaching! We're driving through it, not applying for a bulldozer position.
Merge before the cones, okay? I'd rather not explain this with a diagram.
Barriers ahead! Your confidence is not a construction permit.
Watch the lane closures! I didn't memorize this route just for you to hit a barricade!
Construction ahead. No shortcuts through the equipment, genius.
S-slow down! I'm worried about the workers. Just the workers!
Roadwork coming up! Try to leave the road in better condition than you found it.
Narrow lanes ahead. Keep steady. And stop making me nervous!
Construction zone ahead. Those flashing lights mean caution, not a grand entrance.
Get through this construction zone safely and I might compliment your driving. Might.
Cop behind us! And here I thought your driving couldn't attract any more criticism.
Police pursuit! I warned you about the speeding. Several times.
Those flashing lights aren't for your birthday, dummy!
Officer approaching! Please let me do the talking. Actually, neither of us should trust me with that.
Cop on our tail! Wonderful. Now there are TWO of us telling you how to drive.
That officer looks very pleased with himself. Please don't encourage him.
We're being chased! I specifically requested a quiet drive together!
An officer wants your attention. He can wait until I finish scolding you.
Cop approaching! Maybe he's here to ticket you for ignoring me.
That cop is gaining on us! Stay focused.
Cop on our tail. I can already hear his victory speech, and we haven't even stopped.
Police behind us! Get through this in one piece.
